# Shari Haley Bookkeeping

> Small business bookkeeping, payroll, and tax preparation support in DeLand, Florida, serving Volusia County and Central Florida. Run by Shari Haley, a QuickBooks Platinum Tier and Payroll certified ProAdvisor with more than 25 years of business organization and bookkeeping experience. Legal name: Haley Bookkeeping & Administrative Services. Phone: 386-320-9378. Email: sharihaleybookkeeping@gmail.com.
